english.standardoffencewording:

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.If more than one badger was involved, the fine shall be determined as if there were separate offences for each one.

Time limit for prosecutions: Complex, see section 12ZA.On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
